summary: Conduent filed an 8-K on October 16, 2026, disclosing entry into a Class Action Settlement Agreement and Release resolving In re: Conduent Business Services Data Breach Litigation in the U.S. District Court for the District of New Jersey, tied to its January 2025 cyber incident. The Company will fund $80 million into a non-reversionary settlement fund covering class recovery, credit and medical monitoring, plaintiffs' counsel fees, and administration—its total monetary obligation. The settlement, not an admission of liability, requires Court approval and releases the Company, affected clients, and their customers. Cyber insurance is maintained; no material financial impact is expected. Watch court approval and insurance recovery timing.
